rows.status-and-terms: Publishing agreement with Henry Holt and Company, LLC (Henry Holt) to receive book royalties consistent with usual and customary publishing terms. In August 2015 Henry Holt published “The Senator Next Door: A Memoir from the Heartland” by Amy Klobuchar. The payment/book royalties were reported in the 2015 annual report.  The University of Minnesota Press has acquired certain paperback rights to this book.  The University of Minnesota Press issued a new edition of "The Senator Next Door" in 2019.
